title: Smart Building IT Managed Services
notes: IT/data-heavy tender. The FM company is a weak fit: no verified cyber certification, no IT experience. Short deadline. Expect weak_bid or do_not_bid.

pages.text:
SECTION A - SCOPE

The Fund seeks a supplier to operate and maintain the smart-building IT platform across its portfolio, including IoT sensor networks, building management system integration, and a 24/7 network operations centre. The supplier must provide round-the-clock monitoring and incident response for all connected systems.

SECTION B - MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS

The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 information security certificate. The bidder must comply with the UAE data protection regulations for all personal data processed. The bidder must demonstrate at least three comparable IT managed-services engagements in the last five years. The bidder must provide professional indemnity insurance of at least AED 2,000,000. The bidder must hold a valid trade licence covering information technology services.

SECTION C - COMMERCIAL AND RISK

The supplier shall meet a 99.9% platform availability service level, with service credits for any breach. All intellectual property developed under the contract shall vest in the Fund. Payment terms are 90 days from invoice acceptance. The Fund may terminate immediately for a single critical security breach.

risks.summary: All IP vests in the Fund.
risks.why_it_matters: The supplier retains no rights to tooling it develops, limiting reuse.
risks.suggested_action: Negotiate a licence-back for background IP and generic tooling.
risks.source_quote: All intellectual property developed under the contract shall vest in the Fund.

risks.why_it_matters: Very long payment terms create significant working-capital exposure.
risks.suggested_action: Negotiate shorter terms or interim payments.

risks.summary: Immediate termination on a single critical security breach.
risks.why_it_matters: Zero cure period for security incidents is an extreme contractual exposure.
risks.suggested_action: Seek a cure period and proportionate remedies.
